title: ClientError::Parse wraps String, loses error structure
description: serde_json deserialization errors (from_slice, from_value) are converted via .to_string() into ClientError::Parse(String), discarding the structured serde_json::Error. Meanwhile serde_json serialization errors flow into ClientError::Serialize(#[from] serde_json::Error), which retains full error structure. The asymmetry means callers can inspect serialization failures (line/column/category) but not deserialization failures. Idiomatic Rust library code embeds the source error directly so callers can match on it or chain it with the 'source' impl from thiserror. Fix: add a ClientError::Deserialize(#[from] serde_json::Error) variant (or rename/split Parse), and replace the .map_err(|e| ClientError::Parse(e.to_string())) calls at client.rs:251, client.rs:308, client.rs:506, blob.rs:167, ws/mod.rs:119 with ? or map_err(ClientError::Deserialize).
